flags: Euronet revised its 2026 full-year outlook downward from targets set at its May 2026 Investor Day, citing U.S. immigration policy pressures, global economic pressures, and FX changes in the Cross-Border Payments segment.
Euronet completed the acquisition of 100% of the outstanding equity of CoreCard Corporation, a global modern issuer processor.
Euronet completed the acquisition of a 60% equity stake in UNIDOS CO. LTD (Kyodai Remittance), a leading funds transfer business in Japan.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in P1 (10-K Item 1 Business).
business_model.claim: Euronet is a global electronic payment and transaction processing company serving financial institutions, retailers, service providers, and individual consumers through three reportable segments.
quotes: Euronet is a leader in electronic payment and transaction processing solutions for Financial Institutions, Retailers, Service Providers, and Individual Consumers utilizing our global payments network, platforms, and technologies.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in P4 (10-Q MD&A, period 2026-09-30).
business_model.claim: The Payments Infrastructure segment (renamed from EFT Processing in May 2026) provides ATM and POS transaction processing, card outsourcing, merchant acquiring, and software solutions to financial institutions and consumers across 70 countries.
quotes: The Payments Infrastructure Segment (PI) meets the needs of financial institutions and consumers through Euronet-owned and outsourced ATMs and POS terminals combined with value added and transaction processing services.
PI operates in 70 countries.

business_model.claim: PI revenue is derived from cardholder transaction fees, fixed management fees, DCC foreign-exchange margin, surcharges, foreign currency dispensing, advertising, prepaid recharges, bill payment, and software licensing.
quotes: Revenues in the PI Segment, which represented approximately 38% and 34% of total consolidated revenues for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 are derived from fees charged for transactions made by cardholders on our proprietary network of ATMs, fixed management fees and transaction fees we charge to customers for operating ATMs and processing debit and credit cards under outsourcing and cross-border acquiring agreements, foreign currency exchange margin on DCC transactions, domestic and international surcharge, foreign currency dispensing and other value added services such as advertising, prepaid telecommunication recharges, bill payment, and money transfers provided over ATMs.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in P1 (10-K Item 1) and P3 (10-K MD&A).
business_model.claim: PI transaction volume grew at a five-year CAGR of approximately 37.3%, driven by lower-value, higher-volume digital transactions in Asia Pacific, which dilutes revenue per transaction from $0.10 in 2024 to $0.08 in 2025.
quotes: The number of transactions processed over our networks has increased over the last five years at a compound annual growth rate ("CAGR") of approximately 37.3% as indicated in the following table:
Revenue per transaction was $0.08 and $0.10 for the year ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
The decrease in revenue per transaction is due to an increase in processing digital transactions with a high volume and a low value per transaction.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in P6 (8-K earnings release, October 27, 2026).
business_model.claim: Q3 2026 PI constant-currency revenue growth was driven by merchant acquiring, Ren software sales, and the CoreCard acquisition, partially offset by reduced international ATM cash withdrawals from lower discretionary travel spend.
quotes: Constant currency revenue growth was driven by continued growth in merchant acquiring, Ren sales, and the fourth quarter 2025 acquisition of CoreCard, partially offset by continued economic pressures on discretionary travel spend which negatively affects international ATM cash withdrawals.

business_model.claim: The epay segment provides retail payment solutions and distributes physical and digital third-party content (prepaid mobile airtime, digital media, vouchers, gift cards) through approximately 736,000 POS terminals in 66 countries, earning commissions from mobile operators and content providers.
quotes: The epay Segment provides retail payment solutions and delivers innovative connections between the digital content of the world's leading brands and consumers.

Revenues in the epay Segment, which represented approximately 25% and 27% of total consolidated revenues for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 are primarily derived from commissions or processing fees received from mobile phone operators for the processing and distribution of prepaid mobile airtime and commissions earned from the distribution of other electronic content, vouchers, and physical gifts.

business_model.claim: The Cross-Border Payments segment (renamed from Money Transfer in May 2026) provides global money transfers and currency exchange through Ria, Xe, and the Dandelion platform across 199 countries, earning transaction fees and the margin between wholesale and retail foreign-exchange rates.
quotes: The Cross-Border Payments Segment (CBP) provides global money transfers and currency exchange information in retail stores, apps, and websites through Ria, Xe and the Dandelion cross-border real-time payments network.

Revenues in the CBP Segment, which represented approximately 37% and 39% of total consolidated revenues for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, are primarily derived from transaction fees, as well as the margin earned from purchasing foreign currency at wholesale exchange rates and selling the foreign currency to customers at retail exchange rates.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in P3 (10-K MD&A, FY2025).
business_model.claim: CBP direct operating costs consist primarily of commissions paid to sending agents who originate transfers and correspondent agents who disburse funds to beneficiaries in destination countries.
quotes: Direct operating costs primarily consist of commissions paid to agents who originate money transfers on our behalf and correspondent agents who disburse funds to the customers' destination beneficiaries, together with less significant costs, such as bank depository fees.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in P3 (10-K MD&A, FY2025).
business_model.claim: PI direct operating costs consist of site rental, cash delivery and supply, maintenance, insurance, telecommunications, payment-scheme processing fees, data-center personnel, and commissions paid to retail merchants, banks, and card processors for POS DCC transactions.
quotes: Direct operating costs primarily consist of site rental fees, cash delivery costs, cash supply costs, maintenance, insurance, telecommunications, payment scheme processing fees, data center operations-related personnel, as well as the processing centers' facility-related costs and other processing center-related expenses and commissions paid to retail merchants, banks and card processors involved with POS DCC transactions.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in P6 (8-K earnings release, October 27, 2026).
business_model.claim: U.S. immigration policy changes and the U.S. remittance tax have reduced outbound remittance transaction volumes in key corridors, pressuring CBP revenue, while digital transactions within CBP grew 34% year-over-year in Q3 2026.
quotes: More recently, the U.S. outbound remittance market has experienced lower transaction volumes due to changes in U.S. immigration policies and the implementation of the U.S. remittance tax, which have affected certain remittance corridors.
Total digital transactions of 8.1 million, a 34% increase from 6.1 million.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in P6 (8-K earnings release, October 27, 2026).
business_model.claim: Revenue from the company's digital accelerators (Ria digital, merchant acquiring, Ren product suite) increased 33% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and represented 26% of year-to-date revenues.
quotes: Revenue from the digital accelerators introduced at the Company's Investor Day(*) increased 33% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and represented 26% of year-to-date revenues, demonstrating strong momentum for the continued investments in these strategic initiatives, such as Ria digital, merchant acquiring and the Ren product suite.

business_model.basis: Stated directly in P4 (10-Q MD&A); FY2025 FX impact stated in P3 (10-K MD&A).

The revised outlook reflects immigration-related pressures within the Cross-Border Payments segment in several key corridors, broader global economic pressures and FX conversion rate changes.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited item (10-K Risk Factors)
competitive_position.claim: As a multinational operating in more than 200 countries, Euronet faces legal and operational risks from diverse local regulations, including anti-money laundering, sanctions, data protection, currency controls, and evolving tax rules, with the EU Pillar Two Directive imposing a 15 percent minimum effective tax rate.
quotes: As a multinational company, we face legal and operational risks from diverse local regulations that may impact our operations.

The European Union ("EU") member states formally adopted the EU's Pillar Two Directive, which was established by the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development, and which generally provides for a 15 percent minimum effective tax rate for multinational enterprises, in every jurisdiction in which they operate.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-K MD&A and Business section)
